# Commands

Every command takes `--book` to say which book of record to work on. It
defaults to `shearstud.sqlite3` in the working directory and is never read
from the environment, because a rating office runs one book per district.

## Groups

| Group       | What it covers                                                  |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `campaign`  | Measurement campaigns.                                          |
| `fatigue`   | Fatigue evaluation.                                             |
| `gauge`     | Gauges on the structures.                                       |
| `program`   | The inspection programme: intervals, priority and the worklist. |
| `structure` | Look at and change the inventory.                               |

## Commands

| Command             | What it does                                                          |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `campaign add`      | Record a measurement campaign.                                        |
| `campaign list`     | Campaigns on one structure, oldest first.                             |
| `check`             | Run the structural checks SQLite can do on the book itself.           |
| `fatigue evaluate`  | Evaluate every detail on a structure against one campaign.            |
| `gauge add`         | Record a gauge installation.                                          |
| `gauge list`        | Every gauge in the book.                                              |
| `init`              | Create the book of record, or bring an existing one up to date.       |
| `posting`           | Work the posting decision from the legal load ratings.                |
| `program due`       | Structures whose inspection date has gone past.                       |
| `program record`    | Write down what an inspection found.                                  |
| `program show`      | What the programme currently believes about one structure.            |
| `program worklist`  | The office's list, gaps first.                                        |
| `rate`              | Rate a structure against the legal fleet, or against the design load. |
| `ratings`           | What the book already holds for a structure, newest first.            |
| `shear`             | Rate a structure in shear, ends included.                             |
| `spectrum`          | Read a two column range and count file into the book.                 |
| `status`            | Report the schema version and what the book holds.                    |
| `structure delete`  | Remove a structure and everything hanging off it.                     |
| `structure details` | Every fatigue detail on a structure.                                  |
| `structure export`  | Write a structure back out as a document.                             |
| `structure import`  | Read a structure document into the book.                              |
| `structure list`    | Every structure in the book, in file cabinet order.                   |
| `structure show`    | Everything the book holds about one structure.                        |

## Detail

### `shearstud init`

Create the book of record, or bring an existing one up to date.

### `shearstud status`

Report the schema version and what the book holds.

### `shearstud check`

Run the structural checks SQLite can do on the book itself.

### `shearstud gauge list`

Every gauge in the book.

| Option     | Default | What it does                   |
| ---------- | ------- | ------------------------------ |
| `--detail` |         | Only the gauges on one detail. |

### `shearstud gauge add`

Record a gauge installation.

Takes `gauge_id`, `detail_id`.

| Option          | Default        | What it does                                         |
| --------------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `--installed`   |                | Date the gauge was bonded, YYYY-MM-DD.               |
| `--orientation` | `longitudinal` | Which way the grid runs relative to the girder axis. |
| `--factor`      | `2.1`          | Gauge factor.                                        |
| `--limit`       | `1500.0`       | Channel limit, ue.                                   |
| `--removed`     |                | Date the gauge came off, YYYY-MM-DD.                 |

### `shearstud campaign list`

Campaigns on one structure, oldest first.

Takes `number`.

### `shearstud campaign add`

Record a measurement campaign.

Takes `campaign_id`, `number`.

| Option       | Default | What it does               |
| ------------ | ------- | -------------------------- |
| `--from`     |         | First day, YYYY-MM-DD.     |
| `--to`       |         | Last day, YYYY-MM-DD.      |
| `--seasonal` | `1.0`   | Seasonal factor.           |
| `--note`     | ``      | What the campaign was for. |

### `shearstud spectrum`

Read a two column range and count file into the book.

Takes `campaign_id`, `gauge_id`, `counts`.

| Option        | Default | What it does      |
| ------------- | ------- | ----------------- |
| `--bin-width` | `5.0`   | Bin width, ue.    |
| `--dropout`   |         | Dropout fraction. |
| `--railed`    |         | Railed fraction.  |

### `shearstud fatigue evaluate`

Evaluate every detail on a structure against one campaign.

Takes `number`, `campaign_id`.

| Option                 | Default | What it does                                                |
| ---------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--growth`             |         | Override the recorded traffic growth.                       |
| `--allow-poor-records` |         | Evaluate untrustworthy records too.                         |
| `--save`               |         | Write the evaluations into the book.                        |
| `--condition`          | `7`     | Lowest component condition rating from the last inspection. |

### `shearstud program record`

Write down what an inspection found.

Takes `number`.

| Option        | Default | What it does                                           |
| ------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--condition` |         | Lowest component condition rating from the inspection. |
| `--inspected` |         | Date of the inspection, YYYY-MM-DD.                    |
| `--traffic`   |         | Vehicles a day.                                        |
| `--detour-mi` |         | Miles of detour if the structure closes.               |
| `--posted`    |         | Whether a weight limit is up.                          |

### `shearstud program show`

What the programme currently believes about one structure.

Takes `number`.

### `shearstud program worklist`

The office's list, gaps first.

| Option    | Default | What it does                                |
| --------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `--limit` |         | Print only the first few ranked structures. |
| `--band`  |         | Only one band, by name.                     |

### `shearstud program due`

Structures whose inspection date has gone past.

| Option | Default | What it does                                 |
| ------ | ------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `--on` |         | Ask as at a date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today. |

### `shearstud rate`

Rate a structure against the legal fleet, or against the design load.

Takes `number`.

| Option        | Default | What it does                                     |
| ------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `--stations`  | `10`    | Stations per span.                               |
| `--overlay`   |         | Overlay, inches.                                 |
| `--surface`   | `minor` | Riding surface, for the dynamic allowance.       |
| `--condition` |         | Override the recorded member condition.          |
| `--design`    |         | Rate the design load instead of the legal fleet. |
| `--verbose`   |         | Print a line for every station.                  |
| `--save`      |         | Write the results into the book.                 |

### `shearstud posting`

Work the posting decision from the legal load ratings.

Takes `number`.

| Option       | Default | What it does                      |
| ------------ | ------- | --------------------------------- |
| `--stations` | `10`    | Stations per span.                |
| `--overlay`  |         | Overlay, inches.                  |
| `--save`     |         | Write the decision into the book. |

### `shearstud ratings`

What the book already holds for a structure, newest first.

Takes `number`.

| Option    | Default | What it does   |
| --------- | ------- | -------------- |
| `--limit` | `20`    | How many rows. |

### `shearstud shear`

Rate a structure in shear, ends included.

Takes `number`.

| Option        | Default | What it does                                      |
| ------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `--stations`  | `10`    | Stations per span.                                |
| `--overlay`   |         | Overlay, inches.                                  |
| `--surface`   | `minor` | Riding surface, for the dynamic allowance.        |
| `--condition` |         | Override the recorded member condition.           |
| `--ends-only` |         | Print only the end stations, where shear governs. |
| `--verbose`   |         | Print a line for every station.                   |
| `--save`      |         | Write the results into the book.                  |

### `shearstud structure list`

Every structure in the book, in file cabinet order.

### `shearstud structure show`

Everything the book holds about one structure.

Takes `number`.

| Option      | Default | What it does          |
| ----------- | ------- | --------------------- |
| `--girders` | `True`  | List the girders too. |

### `shearstud structure import`

Read a structure document into the book.

Takes `document`.

| Option         | Default     | What it does                               |
| -------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `--grade`      | `A36`       | Steel grade.                               |
| `--condition`  | `good`      | Member condition.                          |
| `--redundancy` | `redundant` | System redundancy.                         |
| `--adtt`       |             | Truck traffic a day.                       |
| `--lanes`      | `2`         | Lanes open to trucks.                      |
| `--growth`     |             | Traffic growth, %/yr.                      |
| `--force`      |             | Replace a structure that is already there. |

### `shearstud structure export`

Write a structure back out as a document.

Takes `number`, `document`.

### `shearstud structure delete`

Remove a structure and everything hanging off it.

Takes `number`.

| Option  | Default | What it does |
| ------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `--yes` |         | Do not ask.  |

Every fatigue detail on a structure.
